questions.prompt: A student takes two independent driving assessment stages: a theory test followed by a practical test. The probability of passing the theory test is $0.70$. If the theory test is passed, the probability of passing the practical test on the first attempt is $0.40$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the student passes both tests on the first attempt.

questions.prompt: A bag contains $4$ red marbles and $6$ blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn at random from the bag without replacement.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the first marble drawn is red and the second marble drawn is blue.

questions.prompt: Commuters choose between two routes, $A$ and $B$. A commuter chooses route $A$ with probability $0.60$ and route $B$ with probability $0.40$. The probability of encountering a traffic delay on route $A$ is $0.35$, while the probability of encountering a traffic delay on route $B$ is $0.15$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that a randomly chosen commuter encounters a traffic delay.

questions.prompt: A drawer contains $3$ green pens and $5$ yellow pens. Two pens are taken at random from the drawer without replacement.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the two pens are of different colours.

questions.prompt: An archer hits a bullseye with probability $0.30$ on each shot, independently of all other shots. The archer takes $3$ shots.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the archer hits the bullseye exactly twice.

questions.prompt: A box contains $5$ white counters and $3$ black counters. Two counters are picked at random without replacement.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that at least one of the counters picked is black.

questions.prompt: A container holds $5$ red counters and $4$ blue counters. Two counters are drawn successively at random without replacement.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that both counters are of the same colour.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the two counters are of different colours.

questions.prompt: A candidate must qualify through Stage 1 before taking Stage 2 of an audition. The candidate passes Stage 1 on the first attempt with probability $0.80$. If the candidate fails Stage 1 on the first attempt, they are permitted one retest, which they pass with probability $0.50$. Once qualified through Stage 1, the candidate passes Stage 2 with probability $0.75$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the candidate qualifies through Stage 1.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the candidate successfully passes both Stage 1 and Stage 2.

questions.prompt: Box $A$ contains $4$ red tokens and $2$ blue tokens. Box $B$ contains $3$ red tokens and $5$ blue tokens. A fair coin is tossed to select a box: if heads shows, Box $A$ is selected; if tails shows, Box $B$ is selected. Two tokens are then drawn at random without replacement from the selected box.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that both tokens drawn are blue.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Given that both tokens drawn are blue, find the probability that Box $B$ was selected.

questions.prompt: A pouch contains $4$ red marbles and $3$ green marbles. Three marbles are drawn successively at random from the pouch without replacement.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that at least two of the three marbles drawn are green.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Given that at least two of the marbles drawn are green, find the probability that all three marbles drawn are green.

questions.prompt: A bag contains $4$ red discs and $5$ white discs. Ann and Ben take turns removing one disc at random without replacement. Ann takes the first turn. The first player to remove a red disc wins the game.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that Ann wins the game.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that Ben wins the game.

questions.prompt: Bag 1 contains $3$ red balls and $4$ blue balls. Bag 2 contains $4$ red balls and $2$ blue balls. One ball is chosen at random from Bag 1 and transferred into Bag 2 without its colour being observed. Then two balls are drawn at random without replacement from Bag 2.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the ball transferred from Bag 1 to Bag 2 is red.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that both balls drawn from Bag 2 are red.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Given that both balls drawn from Bag 2 are red, find the probability that the ball transferred from Bag 1 was red.

questions.prompt: A box contains $4$ red discs and $4$ white discs. Player $A$ and Player $B$ play a game in which they alternately draw one disc at random without replacement. Player $A$ draws first. A player wins the game immediately upon drawing their second red disc.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that Player $A$ wins the game on their second turn.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that Player $B$ wins the game on their second turn.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Find the probability that the game finishes on or before the fourth draw overall.
